summary: Institutional positioning is heavily focused on long-term, massive-scale hedging and directional bets on the SPX, characterized by massive, balanced accumulation of deep ITM/OTM calls and puts for 2026 and 2027. The most significant conviction is seen in the persistent, multi-day accumulation of SPX 7000C and 8000P strikes (expiring July/August 2026) totaling hundreds of millions in premium, suggesting institutions are building a "strangle" or massive volatility play for the next two years. While NVDA and AMD show bullish call bias (P/C < 1.0), TIGO stands out with an extreme $293.9M single-sided call accumulation for 2026. Traders should watch for continued volatility expansion in SPX and monitor if the massive SPX 7000C/8000P positions lead to a "pinned" or range-bound environment near those levels as the long-dated premium settles.
